verdict.rationale: Mastra Code has its own programmatic surface. Headless `--prompt` and the embeddable `runMC` return structured JSON results, resume or clone threads, and set approval policies. A reference API lets you embed the agent and configure tools, modes, subagents, MCP servers and storage. Nothing documents that this surface matches the interactive TUI feature for feature, and several TUI features have no shown API equivalent. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity guarantee; programmatic equivalents for TUI features such as /login, @-file attach, Goals, queued messages and recurring prompts; a network API/OpenAPI spec (probes 404); independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: `runMC` never calls `process.exit` and never writes to global streams, so it is safe to embed in CI scripts and servers.
A single final JSON object (text, usage, tool calls/results, threadId, status)
Use it to embed Mastra Code in custom applications or extend its functionality.
Resume the most recent thread instead of creating a new one
Programmatic MCP server configs, merged with file-based configs
